item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 25/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to Guangdong in the next couple of days. The temperature difference over inland areas between day and night will be relatively large. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be cloudier over southern China midweek next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach Guangdong in the latter part of next week.
